known_failures: Most of this section is blood clot. The 'unlike training tissue' rule sets aside about 2,000 tiles of it, but a few hundred clot tiles still read as invasive carcinoma and make up nearly all of the small tumor pieces here (checked by eye on tile contact sheets, 2026-10-27). Do not rely on this section's tumor pieces, front or breakaway candidates; most of its map is marked unsure. Section DX3 of the same patient shows the carcinoma.
